body: Blocking review findings fixed (40ad390 + 8096504): on a lathe only nose-cut Facing ahead is credited, and on any machine a turning kind other than that reads raw stock (the mill-turn gap the first fix left; pinned by a test that fails without it) - a turned boring bar, a parting kerf or an ID groove no longer credits the end face; a drill predecessor's point cone is modelled; R just under a faced end is refused; `nose` is in the digest; every Drill stamp carries the stock term (axial drills go Stale on a stock change - saved projects with axial drills read Stale once); `cut_by` keeps NaN; nits done. drill_prior 10, drill_prior_kinds 4, drill_rplane, drill_reach, vertical_rapid_stock, remachining, project_roundtrip 68, operations, posting, turning green; clippy clean. rest.rs is 420+ lines - split noted.
